Chapters guide

Chapter 2: Paradise Lost — GTA 6 progression guide

Lucia takes the lead in Port Gellhorn, based at the Starlet Motel while Jason recovers from the Chapter 1 finale. She builds a life and a bankroll through local jobs — including the vehicle trade run by Moses — until trouble at the motel forces the pair to flee toward Vice City.

Missions — what sources report

Dexerto's verified list counts 11 mandatory missions here; Billy's Thrillbillies and Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab are optional extras, which explains the rival 93-mission whole-game lists. PowerPyx and FinalBoss count roughly 18 Chapter 2 entries because they also number background and setup tasks (Take Care of Jason, Overnight Charges, New Look, Painkiller Supplier, Prepare for Vice City).

What unlocks

  • Vehicle registration at Moses' Watkins Auto Parts — and the first registration is free (mission: Moses)
  • Slim Jim lockpick tool (mission: Moses)
  • Upgraded WAiNK scanner showing sale value, registration cost and tracker status
  • Scooter Bros vehicle delivery app
  • Selling stolen cars to Moses
  • Port Gellhorn Station Garage, free (after Daily Driver)
  • Vice City Real Estate app for buying garages (after Daily Driver)
  • Pawn shops open — collectible cards can be sold from this chapter
  • Dunk as a fence for marked bills and goods (after Slam Dunk)
  • Free-roam character switching (after Coffee Break, per FinalBoss)
  • Paradise Garage, free for Ultimate Edition owners (Chapter 2)

Free grabs this act

  • Your first registered personal car — the registration fee is waived once, and later registrations run $1,400 to $40,650
  • The Vapid Montagne XL parked behind Moses' shop, if you want his offered car
  • Port Gellhorn Station Garage (free, story)
  • $5,000 Rainy Day Fund from the lockbox in Jason's burned house — KeenGamer says Lucia can collect it in Chapter 2; RareThief says it becomes reachable partway through Chapter 3
  • Classic Car Collection exploration set (Ultimate Edition, Chapter 2)

Warnings & traps

  • Checking Out closes the chapter and permanently removes the motel as your home — finish Port Gellhorn business first
  • The chapter's $15,000 'Prepare for Vice City' target must be spendable cash: money in Family Savings cannot be spent, so build the total in pocket cash and checking
  • Moses refuses any car with a tracker and any car stolen close to his own shop
  • Fextralife reports two collectible cards (Delights Dancers, Los Santos Corkers) must be picked up before the end of Chapter 2; PowerPyx lists no missable cards — disputed, but grabbing motel-area cards before Checking Out costs nothing
  • Do the Pelican Valley crab outpost in this chapter, not Chapter 1 — its cash is a one-time pickup and Chapter 1 earnings are wiped

Sources & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Walkthrough: All Chapters and Story Missions in Order — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Source: Moses in GTA 6: Port Gellhorn's car fence — gta6.house.

Source: GTA 6 best cars to steal, register and sell to Moses — thegta6map.com.

Source: All Garage Locations And Prices In GTA 6 — GameSpot.

Source: GTA 6 Mission List — All Chapters and Missions — Dexerto.

Unlock timings for Moses, the Slim Jim and the free garage are consistent across every guide. Daily Driver pays $1,250 + $500 condition (Exputer, gta.guide), and the chapter's money gates — $5,000 earned, then $15,000 for 'Prepare for Vice City' before Checking Out — are confirmed by Space4Games and KeenGamer (the counters track earnings toward the goal, not your BuckMe balance). Open disputes: the Rainy Day Fund's earliest collection point (Chapter 2 vs mid-Chapter 3) and whether any cards are missable at the chapter's end.
